mathematical_meanings: Left image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right tip of the horizontal axis through the blue circle). Right image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right arrow of the horizontal axis beside the two branches).
Rationales: In both images, x names the horizontal coordinate axis. The relevant locations are the right tip of the horizontal axis through the blue circle on the left and the right arrow of the horizontal axis beside the two branches on the right.
